note: Screening knobs that used to be literal defaults in function signatures. Moved here for the same reason fab_profiles.json exists: a number written in three places drifts into three different numbers, and the disagreement is silent. Every entry carries the rationale the CODE already stated; where the code stated none, rationale says so rather than inventing one. There is deliberately no built-in fallback - see common/tuning.py.

max_distance_mm.rationale: Datasheet-typical upper bound. VIOLATION threshold: a cap further than this is reported as a finding.
max_distance_mm.source: decoupling_coverage.py's own DEFAULT_MAX_DISTANCE_MM comment: 'a datasheet-typical upper bound'

target_distance_mm.rationale: The tighter placement target. Exceeding it is REPORTED but is not a violation - it is the goal, not the limit.
target_distance_mm.source: same comment: 'a tighter placement target'; was measure_board.py's and ngspice.py's default limit before this file existed

rule_multiplier.rationale: The 3W rule: parallel high-speed traces stay >= 3x the trace width apart.

violation_weight.unit: cost units per mm of shortfall
violation_weight.rationale: How hard the A* search is pushed away from a 3W shortfall. A search-tuning weight, not a physical quantity.
violation_weight.source: no rationale was stated in the code; recorded here as unexplained rather than given an invented one

via_cost.rationale: Extra path cost charged for a layer change, so the router prefers staying on one layer.
via_cost.source: no rationale was stated in the code; grid_astar's _heuristic_3d only notes that GUESSING this number would break A* admissibility

ambient_temp_c.rationale: Reference ambient for the RthetaJA path when no measured case temperature is available.
ambient_temp_c.source: no rationale was stated in the code. 25 C is the usual datasheet reference condition, NOT this product's enclosure ambient - a real enclosure figure must replace it before a thermal claim is made.

drop_pct_tiers.rationale: Rule-of-thumb tiers answering 'how much extra capacitance for how bad a drop'. null max_drop_pct is the open-ended top tier.
drop_pct_tiers.source: ngspice.py's own comment: a precise C = I*dt/dV needs transient dI/dt and ESR data that the finding does not carry; a real PDN/ESR analysis must confirm a critical rail
